story.heading: Our Matcha
body: Nekohama's A1 Organic is our cornerstone ceremonial-grade matcha — a first-harvest, single-origin matcha made from tencha leaves grown in the volcanic soils of Kagoshima, Japan, using a cultivar blend of Sayamakaori, Okumidori, Saemidori and Yabukita.

Flavor-wise it's naturally sweet and creamy with a strong umami note and no bitterness. It's JAS-certified organic, milled monthly using modern low-heat, low-moisture grinding technology that preserves colour and aroma.

callout.label: Water Temperature
callout.note: Never use boiling water — it scorches the delicate green tea powder and creates an overly bitter, harsh taste.

method: Add the matcha into a warm bowl.
Whisk briskly in a zig-zag “W” or “M” motion with a bamboo whisk until smooth and frothy.
